posts.title: Moltbot first impressions: it really feels like an AI intern
posts.description: I’ve been playing around with Moltbot (formerly ClawdBot) for a while now. Bottom line: it’s genuinely fun. None of the ideas are new on their own, but the way they come together is surprisingly compelling. Fair warning though—the bugs can be brutal.
